decisions.finding: Beneath the base of Bet in בִּירוּשָׁלִָם sits a sharp, isolated circular ink node at rows 41..46 (width 6 px, ink density > 65%) with clear surrounding margins. Matches control Hiriq dot under Dalet in וְתַלְמַי בְּנוֹ. Certified printed Hiriq (U+05B4).

Under the horizontal base and stem of Lamed in ליסִימָכוֹס, there is an uninterrupted band of clean uninked paper extending 16 rows downward. No vowel mark was engraved or printed. Confirmed unpointed consonant.
Initial Vav in וקלֵיאוֹפַטְרָה is a narrow vertical stem without interior Dagesh or Shuruq point, and white paper flanking both sides. Confirmed unpointed conjunctive Vav.

Under the right horizontal base and left vertical descending stroke of Qof in וקלֵיאוֹפַטְרָה, the paper is completely blank for 15 vertical pixels. No vowel was printed. Confirmed unpointed consonant.

The internal cavity of Pe (letter 7 of וקלֵיאוֹפַטְרָה) is pure white paper with no Dagesh point; a distinct horizontal Patah bar is visible beneath the letter. Confirmed unpointed consonant regarding Dagesh (bare Pe with Patah פַ).
